svg.title: Hazardous materials responder — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as hazardous materials responder, wearing a protective suit and a protective hood. Visible work cue: A marked hazardous-materials container sits above a respirator with two separate filter cartridges. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a protective hood.
